entries.t: <FACE:79>Supplies strewn all<NL>over the place…<WAIT>Crates left wide open…<WAIT><FACE:7A>What is the meaning of<NL>this!<NL>
<FACE:7A>While I was away, keep<NL>this place in order!<WAIT>I told you over and<NL>over! What a mess!
<FACE:7A>My honor is in ruins!!
<FACE:81>We're sorry-robo,<NL>Boss Raiun…<WAIT>We had to rush an arm<NL>to grab the Cluster<WAIT>We fell behind-robo…
<FACE:79>Hmm… Winging it is the<NL>Sperobo Gang's motto…
<FACE:79>But still! Only by<NL>keeping proper order<WAIT>can our supply corps<NL>keep its pride!!
<FACE:79>Anyway, clean this up<NL>at once!<NL><WAIT>If the enemy saw this,<NL>it'd shame us all!
<FACE:08>Ugh, what is all this…<NL>It's a total mess!
<FACE:7C>Gah!
<FACE:0A>Ah… evil gangs are<NL>just a pack of slobs
<FACE:7A>Ngggh…
<FACE:14>My room's bad enough,<NL>but this beats it…
<FACE:19>Leader, look out, sir!<NL>It's all coming down!
<FACE:7A>W-why you…
<FACE:0A>I'd love to see who<NL>runs this Block…
<FACE:7A>Enooough!!!<NL>I've had it!<NL>
<FACE:7A>Stand right there!!<NL>I'll take you on!!
<FACE:79>Ngh…!<NL><WAIT>Heh… heh heh heh<NL>You think you've won,<WAIT>but our plan has hit<NL>its final stage…
<FACE:79>Press on all you like,<NL>will you make it?<WAIT>Bwaa ha ha ha!
<FACE:38>Trouble! They're using<NL>optical Medabots<WAIT>outside to tear off<NL>the Cluster boosters!
<FACE:01>Dammit!<NL>No time to go back!<WAIT>What can we even do…
<FACE:22>Please wait! Humble as<NL>I am, let me, Niwaka,<WAIT>ex class president,<NL>guard the Cluster!
<FACE:08>Niwaka!?<WAIT><FACE:03>Niwaka!
<FACE:22>I have now completely<NL>come to my senses!<WAIT>This time I'll give my<NL>life for the class!<WAIT>Leave this to me<NL><WAIT>The rest of you focus<NL>on those villains!
<FACE:08>He hung up…
<FACE:06>With his skill there's<NL>no way he can win!
<FACE:02>Now, now… Niwaka does<NL>seem to have changed…
<FACE:00>Besides, we won't make<NL>it. Trust Niwaka! Go!
<FACE:00>We won't make it if we<NL>don't hurry
<FACE:00>Nice, real nice<NL>This armor
<FACE:04>This is what happens<NL>if you never tidy up…
<FACE:00>Rows of difficult<NL>books here…
